step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram depicts an automated, self-service employee provisioning system built by Olikka. The flow starts with AWS DeepLens capturing a photo of a arriving person and sending it to an 'IDENTITY' Lambda function. The Lambda invokes Amazon Rekognition to identify the user, stores the employee image in Amazon S3, and caches the presence record in Amazon DynamoDB. In the second interaction, the user speaks to Alexa, triggering the 'WKSP HELPER' Lambda function. This Lambda queries DynamoDB to identify who is present, prompts Alexa with a personalized message, and upon user confirmation, triggers AWS Step Functions to provision an Amazon Workspace.
